question: Balanoglossus belongs to which of the following phylum of animal kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hemichordata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemichordata: **

 
 
• This phylum includes marine worm-like creatures, such as acorn worms (like Balanoglossus) and graptolites.
 
• Hemichordates are characterized by pharyngeal slits, similar to those of chordates, and a structure known as a stomochord in the collar, which is similar to the notochord in chordates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arthropoda: **

 
 
• This is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom and includes creatures like insects, spiders, and crustaceans.
 
• Arthropods are characterized by their jointed legs (the word "arthropoda" means "jointed feet" in Greek) and a hard exoskeleton made of chitin.
 
 
 
• **Echinodermata:**
 
 
• This phylum includes marine animals like starfish, sea urchins, and sea cucumbers.
 
• Echinoderms are characterized by radial symmetry, spiny skin, and a water vascular system that aids in locomotion, feeding, and respiration.
 
 
 
• **Mollusca:**
 
 
• This is one of the most diverse phyla and includes animals like snails, octopuses, and clams.
 
• Molluscs are characterized by a soft body, which in many species is protected by a hard shell, and a muscular 'foot' used for movement.
